text:
Maya: Heads up — trial users keep misinterpreting the small 'KMS' pill on Instance rows. They think BYOK is on by default.
Sam: Oof. Can we make the pill explicit about provider + alias? e.g. 'AWS KMS · alias/ri-prod-key'
Maya: Yes. And the current hover tooltip vanishes for keyboard users.
Devon: We should add a focusable disclosure (chevron) instead of hover-only. Use aria-expanded + aria-controls so screen readers get the same content.
Aisha: From security: always show authority (AWS/GCP/Azure) and a short badge if key is customer-managed vs platform-managed. e.g. 'Encrypted — AWS KMS (customer managed)'.
Sam: Also display alias prominently; offer a secondary action to reveal full key id + last rotation. The id is noisy and shouldn't be inline.
Oliver: Audit logs inconsistency: we have "encryption key updated" vs "KMS key rotated" in different places. Propose one pattern: "[actor] [verb] [resource] — from [old] to [new] (ts tz)"
Maya: Good. And retention presets are confusing: 'Short/Default/Long' — testers asked what that means.
Devon: Quick fix: inline durations. 'Short (7d)', 'Default (30d)', 'Long (365d)'. Add an sr-only description for screen readers.
Aisha: MUST: retention change events include previous_value -> new_value and operator identity. Right now audit only records the new value which is useless for investigations.
Sam: Verb whitelist suggestion: created, attached, detached, rotated, updated, deleted. Use those consistently across UI + audit.
Maya: UX to-dos: 1) Pill becomes 'Encryption (AWS KMS)' + alias. 2) Add keyboard-expand affordance that reveals full key id & rotation ts. 3) Retention presets show durations + sr-only labels. 4) Audit events include previous_value and use verb whitelist.
Devon: Implementation notes: disclosure will be a popover, absolutely positioned, animated with transform to avoid layout shifts in compact panels.
Oliver: I'll draft sample audit messages and add them to the style guide. Example: "Alice rotated KMS key for Instance foo — from alias/old to alias/new (2024-06-12T15:03:00Z PDT)"
Maya: I'll update Figma and annotate accessibility requirements.
Devon: Will prototype and drop a demo gif in the thread.
ux-bot: Reminder — design review sync Fri 10:00. Added this thread to the agenda.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll file follow-up tickets (#ui-ux, #security-audit) after the mock is uploaded.
